posts.title: More Poetry
posts.description: It should come as no surprise, if one were to review what I have posted here, that I like poetry. Reading it. Writing it. Nearly any style or time. I like the way poetry treats words and phrases and personally wish to be surrounded by more of it. I have some notes that I keep.
